field_caveats: Big-collab papers (ATLAS / CMS / LIGO / etc.) require analyzer / convener / paper-editor evidence beyond simple author-list overlap. Use same_working_group or analysis_contact_overlap edges for these.
Theory vs experiment matters for advisor matching — check candidate's recent papers.
INSPIRE-HEP collaboration tracking is more authoritative than Google Scholar for HEP author lists.
exclusion_rules: no matching paper in last 3 years (the candidate has pivoted away or stopped publishing)
emeritus / dean / chair-only / full admin role (not actively running a lab)
fully pivoted to industry (no current academic affiliation)
no PhD students currently in the lab (check the 'people' / 'group' page)
explicitly 'not recruiting' on the lab / faculty page
lab page returned 404 / no group page exists (cannot verify recruiting)
